name: agent-skills-manager
description: Discover user-selected GitHub Agent Skills; manage approved changes using verified native paths or an optional private collection.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and manage GitHub Agent Skills
interface.longDescription: Discover skills from GitHub repositories you select. Browse read-only, inspect accessible installed skills, and review one plan before changes. Prefer verified native skill installation where supported; provide manual ChatGPT Skills UI steps when write tools are unavailable. An authorized user-owned private Plugin Creator collection is an optional fallback. No preset repositories, third-party skills, or shared user data.
capabilities: Discover Agent Skills in user-selected GitHub repositories without installation
Inspect accessible installed skills and report unavailable status honestly
Plan approval-gated native or authorized private-collection changes
defaultPrompt: Find Agent Skills in a GitHub repository I will provide. Show candidates without installing anything.
Show the skills installed in my accessible collection, or explain which inventory is unavailable.
Check for updates to my installed skills. Show findings without applying any changes.
